summary.headline: Astrological Questions, 137–159
summary.text: Entries 137–159 of an astrological work list questions on letters, childbirth, hiding things, nativities, illnesses, loans, buying and selling, sowing, tree planting, star sizes, eclipses, and the motion of the starless sphere, with references to codex Bonon. 18 and a Catal. edition.
